tasks.title: Setup Dashboard Frontend Framework
tasks.description: Initialize and configure the React/Next.js frontend framework with responsive design for the Performance Monitoring Dashboard
tasks.details:
1. Create a new Next.js project using `npx create-next-app@latest`
2. Configure project structure following best practices:
   - `/components` for reusable UI components
   - `/pages` for route-based components
   - `/hooks` for custom React hooks
   - `/styles` for CSS/SCSS files
   - `/utils` for helper functions
   - `/context` for React context providers
3. Set up responsive design using CSS Grid/Flexbox or a UI library like Chakra UI or Material UI
4. Configure WebSocket client for real-time updates
5. Implement basic layout components:
   - Main navigation
   - Dashboard grid system
   - Responsive containers
6. Set up routing for different dashboard sections
7. Configure environment variables for API endpoints
8. Implement basic loading states and error boundaries
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for core components using React Testing Library
2. Responsive design testing across multiple viewport sizes
3. Performance testing to ensure <3 second load time
4. WebSocket connection testing
5. Cross-browser compatibility testing
6. Accessibility testing using axe or similar tools

tasks.title: Implement Express.js Backend with WebSocket Support
tasks.description: Develop the Express.js backend server with WebSocket support for real-time data transmission
tasks.details:
1. Initialize Express.js project with TypeScript support
2. Set up project structure:
   - `/controllers` for request handlers
   - `/routes` for API endpoints
   - `/services` for business logic
   - `/models` for data models
   - `/middleware` for request processing
   - `/utils` for helper functions
3. Implement WebSocket server using Socket.IO or ws library
4. Create API endpoints for dashboard data:
   - GET /api/metrics/volume
   - GET /api/metrics/quality
   - GET /api/metrics/conversion
   - GET /api/metrics/stealth
5. Implement authentication middleware
6. Set up CORS configuration
7. Implement error handling middleware
8. Configure environment variables
9. Set up logging with Winston or similar
10. Implement rate limiting for API protection
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for controllers and services using Jest
2. Integration tests for API endpoints
3. WebSocket connection and event tests
4. Load testing to ensure handling of 1,000+ requests per minute
5. Authentication and authorization tests
6. Error handling tests

tasks.title: Set Up Redis for Real-time Data Caching
tasks.description: Configure Redis as a real-time data cache for the dashboard to ensure <1 second data refresh latency
tasks.details:
1. Set up Redis server (local for development, managed service for production)
2. Implement Redis client in the backend using ioredis or node-redis
3. Create data caching strategies:
   - Set up TTL (Time-To-Live) for different data types
   - Implement cache invalidation patterns
   - Configure pub/sub channels for real-time updates
4. Create cache service with methods:
   - `setMetricData(key, data, ttl)`
   - `getMetricData(key)`
   - `invalidateCache(pattern)`
   - `publishUpdate(channel, data)`
   - `subscribeToUpdates(channel, callback)`
5. Implement cache warming for frequently accessed data
6. Set up Redis monitoring and health checks
7. Configure Redis persistence for data recovery
8. Implement connection pooling for high throughput
9. Create cache hit/miss metrics for performance monitoring
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for cache service methods
2. Integration tests for Redis operations
3. Performance testing for cache response times
4. Load testing with simulated high traffic
5. Failover and recovery testing
6. Memory usage monitoring tests
